My dear [Mrs Harrison](../persons.html#638)[^1]
A great many thanks for the exceedingly nice frame, and all the arrangements for setting up the collects. I waited to thank you till they actually appeared so that I might acknowledge them at the same time.

They are very nice and I am sure they will be a great pleasure to many, and help out many a Sunday

yours affectionately

C M Yonge

[^1]: Sophia Jane (Collinson) Harrison (1826-1891), wife of the railway engineer Thomas Elliot Harrison (1808-1888) was certainly a correspondent of CMY\'s and a philanthropist, but proof is lacking that this letter is definitely to her.
